source_focus.source_title: After Vero Beach arrest, experts warn of dangers of posting photos online - WPBF
source_focus.source_lead: A Vero Beach man, Peter Ruma, is accused of using artificial intelligence to turn social media photos into pornography, raising concerns about the dangers of posting images on social media. Greg Schiller, CEO of the Boca Raton-based nonprofit Child Rescue Coalition, said this type of activity is becoming increasingly common. "Everyone's got to be concerned about what people are potentially doing with their images," Schiller said.
